Open the PDB that names the atoms. DCD stores coordinates only, so this is required for them.

interactive.tooltip: Drop every frame that contains an atom-atom clash and write a new DCD trajectory.

interactive.tooltip: mdtraj atom-selection expression. The listed atoms' pairwise distances are tested; a frame is dropped when any pair is closer than the minimum distance.

interactive.label: stride
interactive.tooltip: Read every Nth frame of the source trajectory.

interactive.label: min_distance
interactive.tooltip: Minimum allowed atom-atom distance in Ångström. Frames with any selected atom pair closer than this are removed.
